summary: ZenaTech filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release reporting Q2 and first-half 2026 results, not a special situation. Q2 revenue reached C$9.3 million, up 316% year-over-year from C$2.2 million, while first-half revenue was C$17.7 million, up 425% from C$3.4 million. Drone-as-a-Service contributed roughly 93% of revenue. The company disclosed 29 cumulative DaaS acquisitions, cash of C$12.2 million, total assets above C$149 million, new South Korea and UK offices, and Russell 3000 Index inclusion. No deal terms or board recommendation were stated.
